The '''Treema Courthouse and Detention Area''' was a jail in [[Treema]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]] were held here in [[44 ABY]], along with the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]], after Stadd nearly disrupted the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]]. They were soon released by Skywalker's and Khai's respective fathers, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]].
